lewis-pass-highway-hanmer-springs-murchi.title: Lewis Pass Highway: Hanmer Springs to Murchison
lewis-pass-highway-hanmer-springs-murchi.slogan: Hanmer Springs to Murchison on the Lewis Pass Highway · one way, about 245 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Hanmer Springs
waypoints.advice: Hanmer Springs is where the day begins. Next is Lewis Pass.

waypoints.name: Lewis Pass
waypoints.advice: Lewis Pass comes up 123 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Murchison, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Murchison
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 245 km.

sections.advice: Hanmer Springs → Lewis Pass climbs about 864 m in 48 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lewis Pass → Murchison drops about 864 m over 80 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

lewis-pass-highway-hanmer-springs-murchi.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Lewis Pass Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Hanmer Springs → Lewis Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 92 km. 864 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Lewis Pass → Murchison
scenicChapters.narrative: 153 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

lewis-pass-highway-hanmer-springs-murchi.story: The highest point is about 1,000 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.narrative: For 36 km this is Wachau Danube Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Ybbs - Kleinkastell → Wallsee - Kleinkastell
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 42 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
